historical_functional_chain.same_topology_judgement: The historical T020/T021 board run positively exercised T017 SLD topology. T017 and T027 synthesized alt_sld_fab_0 metadata are byte-identical after timestamp removal, so topology identity is the same. This is historical evidence only; it is not a new T027 board test and does not prove warning-free synthesis.

qsf_ip_findings: catapult_a10.qsf explicitly retains Qsys EMIF IP and both JTAG-UART Verilog inputs; it contains no SLD disable, endpoint removal, MESSAGE_DISABLE, filter or waiver assignment.

Qsys_emif_bot.ip has diagnostic declarations DIAG_EXPORT_VJI=false, DIAG_ENABLE_JTAG_UART=false and EMIF debug export disabled in tracked IP metadata; changing these would alter or disable debug topology and is not a repair that preserves both observed endpoints.

The tracked generated JTAG-UART Verilog contains five 'altera message_off ... 16788' comments (lines 18, 75, 161, 240, 329). This is message suppression, explicitly outside the repair definition, and does not suppress the generated SLD hub warning in T027.
The same generated Verilog has SLD_AUTO_INSTANCE_INDEX=YES only inside a commented alt_jtag_atlantic block (lines 558-574); it is not an active source-qualified topology repair.

git ls-files has no tracked alt_sld_fab_0 or altera_sld_jtag_hub generated source. T017->T027 relevant QSF/IP/JTAG source hashes are unchanged; only rtl/lcvex_decode.sv changed for the decoder repair.

proposed_source_qualified_contract.raw_detail_summary_contract: For current Quartus 21.4, exactly one generated canonical identity may occur as one detail row plus one summary row (T027: one syn.smsg line and one syn.rpt summary row). Any extra/missing raw row, unrecognized detail/summary form, or second identity fails closed.
proposed_source_qualified_contract.topology_contract: Normalized synthesized alt_sld_fab_0.sopcinfo SHA256 must equal b127700cfe079af2b01bfc5bcfea3926d2d97d7317d79cad943658d117ff532e; module/hpath set, endpoint hpaths, SETTINGS/type-code/IR-width sequence, COUNT=2, N_SEL_BITS=2, N_NODE_IR_BITS=5, NODE_INFO and node_0/node_1 widths (1/3) must match. Any count, signature, endpoint or topology drift fails closed.
proposed_source_qualified_contract.freshness: Report and sopcinfo must come from the same fresh synthesis root; missing/stale artifacts fail closed. Any tracked RTL/QSF/IP/topology/tool-version change requires a new physical evidence task and fresh authorized flow.
